items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: I started playing ... with a lot of good drummers: Malcolm Pinson

ctx.x: Yeah you had the classic dream that most of us had at that age and it came true for you.
Yeah. Yeah. And once I got in the network then I started playing — I became a night person, it’s a wonder I made it through school because I was playing a lot of sessions © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-

with a lot of good drummers: Malcolm Pinson; a great drummer named Carl Lott who’s still alive, a great drummer; Richie Lockwood, I don’t know what happened to Richie. But man, and there were at least four or five full time jazz clubs in Houston back then.
